name: steer@3b
after: steer@3, merged in PR 1809; same model, trial, cells, tiers and prompts

variants.target: each raised concept at least base + t, each lowered one at most base - t, where t is the cell's best design-point score plus reach (log10(2) where no design point meets the cell); uniq, coh and drift constraints as in steer@3; starts at the best design point
variants.center: the same goals, starting at the zero design

claims.target: on training prompts, target queries beat the design lookup in at least 8 of the 24 cells
claims.center: reported: cells where center queries meet the cell at all, and their score against lookup
